parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` and `Talkset.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` — carry `is_test: true` and belong to the `PlaylistTesting` source group within the `Playlist` package. Stub factory methods are intentionally per-type fixtures; their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) reflects the shared pattern of constructing test doubles, not accidental duplication. Merging them would conflate two distinct domain types (`Playcut` and `Talkset`) and undermine the clarity of each type's test fixture.
